name: mira-extraction
description: Extract a research paper (PDF or text) into a validated MIRA graph — Question/Claim/Evidence/Study/Protocol/SourceDocument/Request nodes connected by the MIRA relations, emitted as canonical MIRA JSON-LD and checked against the schema's own SHACL shapes. Developed by SciOS as the extraction engine of RRGI and contributed upstream. A draft for human review; publishes nothing, signs nothing.
